ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.description: Digest identifies immutable bytes using a named digest algorithm.

algorithm.description: algorithm identifies the canonical digest algorithm, for example sha256.

hex.description: hex is the lower-case encoded digest value.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Digest.jsonschema.title: Digest

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GitSnapshot.jsons.description: GitSnapshot is server-authored canonical metadata for one committed tree.

commitOid.description: commit_oid is the resolved local committed Git object ID.

policyDigest.description: policy_digest is authored after normalizing ignore and symlink policy.

snapshotId.description: snapshot_id names the immutable snapshot fact.

treeOid.description: tree_oid is the exact root tree resolved from commit_oid.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.GitSnapshot.jsons.title: Git Snapshot

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier
